name: Baasi
description_en:
Baasi describes a communication platform and API combining meetings, messaging, recording and tenant/user management. The current official home page explicitly says it is running in test mode and repeatedly invites visitors to a waitlist. Its advertised feature set should therefore be read as vendor documentation, with production availability unconfirmed.

The distinctive proposed workflows include private spoken “whispers” during a group meeting and participant-specific recording layouts. Neither was exercised in this research, and no generally available paid plan was established.
description_zh:
Baasi 将自身描述为结合会议、消息、录制及租户/用户管理的通信平台和 API。当前官方首页明确写处于测试模式，并多次邀请加入候补名单；功能宣传因此应按厂商文档理解，生产可用性未确认。

较有辨识度的拟议流程包括群组会议中的私密语音“耳语”以及按参与者区分的录制布局。本次均未执行，也未确立普遍可购的付费套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: The page describes spoken side conversations without other meeting members hearing them; not tested isolation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 页面描述其他成员听不到的语音侧边对话，但未测试隔离效果。

core_features.explanation_en: The page lists separate participant recordings, speaker metadata and different layouts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 页面列出分别录制参与者、发言者元数据及不同布局。

en: A team interested in interpretation or backstage speaker coordination could ask for authorized evaluation access. Define who may enter a whisper, who should hear the main room and what each recording should contain. In a controlled rehearsal, verify isolation, a return to the main conversation and playback of each intended recording track. This is an editorial evaluation scenario; no account, session or recording was created.
zh: 有口译或后台发言协调需求的团队，可询问获授权的评估访问。应定义谁能进入耳语、谁应听见主会场及各录制包含内容，在受控彩排验证隔离、返回主讨论及各预期音轨回放。这是编辑评估情境，本次未创建账户、会话或录制。

sections.title_en: Example: an internal rehearsal rather than a production promise
sections.title_zh: 示例：内部彩排而非生产承诺
sections.en:
A team interested in interpretation or backstage speaker coordination could ask for authorized evaluation access. Define who may enter a whisper, who should hear the main room and what each recording should contain. In a controlled rehearsal, verify isolation, a return to the main conversation and playback of each intended recording track. This is an editorial evaluation scenario; no account, session or recording was created.

The test-mode banner and waitlist prevent assuming immediate self-service production onboarding. The site also discusses third-party CPaaS integration with limitations, so a capability in an upstream service is not automatically an unrestricted Baasi feature.
sections.zh:
有口译或后台发言协调需求的团队，可询问获授权的评估访问。应定义谁能进入耳语、谁应听见主会场及各录制包含内容，在受控彩排验证隔离、返回主讨论及各预期音轨回放。这是编辑评估情境，本次未创建账户、会话或录制。

测试模式横幅及候补入口使人不能假定立即自助投入生产。网站也讨论带限制的第三方 CPaaS 集成，因此上游服务能力不自动成为 Baasi 无限制功能。

sections.title_en: A stated usage model without a numeric tariff
sections.title_zh: 有用量模型但没有数字费率
sections.en:
The home page says the same API can support VoIP and video and that charging depends on service type and minutes used. It provides no numeric rate in the read text. The terms additionally contemplate setup, one-time, overage, per-use and recurring subscription charges. These broad contractual categories do not establish that all apply to a given offer. Obtain a written scope for the particular service, usage unit, recording storage, support and renewal period.

The terms state charges are generally non-cancelable/non-refundable for the applicable term subject to stated exceptions, and describe advance notice of changes. This is a summary of the vendor text, not legal interpretation. No price, currency, free quota, concurrency allowance or checkout was verified.
sections.zh:
首页表示同一 API 可用于 VoIP 和视频，并按服务类型及使用分钟计费，但已读正文没有数字费率。条款另列设置、一次性、超额、按次及循环订阅费用等可能类别；宽泛合同类别不代表某个报价全部适用。应取得特定服务、用量单位、录制存储、支持及续期周期的书面范围。

条款说明，在列明例外条件下，适用周期费用通常不可取消/退款，并描述价格变更的提前通知。这是厂商文本摘要，不是法律解读。未核实价格、币种、免费配额、并发额度或结账。

sections.title_en: Resolve launch status and control boundaries first
sections.title_zh: 先确认上线状态及控制边界
sections.en:
The terms distinguish organizational use and administrator-assigned accounts; the administrator may access or disable an account. Recording terms discuss user responsibility, notifications and stored recordings. Before any pilot, establish user roles, recording consent, access and deletion arrangements with the organization and vendor. Do not infer tested privacy from whisper terminology or certification claims.

A communications development team may investigate the API, but an organizer requiring a ready-to-run dependable event should first establish actual availability, supported clients and operational support. Production release status, SDK initialization, licence/self-hosting rights, tenant isolation, regulatory suitability, media quality and recovery remain unverified. This record is a documentation draft with explicit test-stage conditions.
sections.zh:
条款区分组织使用及管理员分配账户，管理员可能访问或停用账户。录制条款讨论用户责任、通知及录制存储。试点前应与组织及厂商明确用户角色、录制同意、访问及删除安排，不能从“耳语”名称或认证宣传推断隐私已实测。

通信开发团队可调查 API，但需要可靠即用活动的组织者，应先确认实际可用性、支持客户端及运营支持。生产发布状态、SDK 初始化、许可/自托管权、租户隔离、监管适用、媒体质量和恢复仍未核实。本档案是明确标注测试阶段条件的文档草稿。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Production availability, actual offer, API credentials/client setup, licence rights and all operational claims unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 生产可用性、实际报价、API 凭据/客户端配置、许可权及全部运营主张未核实。
